bullets.text: MNOs Gear Up for mmWave – Ofcom approves UK operators for upcoming mmWave spectrum auction, enhancing 5G capabilities.
Virgin Media O2 Launches Giga Site – The first UK 5G Giga Site in London promises over 10 Gbps throughput.
EE's 5G+ Expansion Plans – EE aims to cover 130 cities with its rebranded 5G+ network by 2025.
VMO2's Giga Site Rollout – Virgin Media O2 plans to deploy 1,000 Giga Sites nationwide to enhance 5G connectivity.
Boldyn's Private Network Strategy – Boldyn Networks advances private and neutral-host networks in London and beyond.
Device Intelligence in Private Networks – GSMA highlights the need for device visibility to secure private networks.
Airbus Expands Private 5G – Airbus partners with Ericsson to deploy private 5G networks in Germany and France.
